Definition: from G1094; to be senescent:--be (wax) old.
BiblicalUsage: gēráskō means be (wax) old. It turns up twice, in John and Hebrews.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: gēráskō means be (wax) old, and I do not stretch it further.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Appears to Seven Disciples by the Sea of Galilee
